newsitem.title: USA: TCI and TCA Cable in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: TCI and TCA Cable in joint venture.

text.p: TCI Communications Inc said Friday that it has signed a letter of intent to establish a partnership with TCA Cable TV Inc to operate cable systems in Texas, Louisiana and New Mexico.
The company said it will control 20 percent of the venture when it is closes, subject to regulatory and board approval, while TCA will be the managing partner for the venture.
TCI said it will contribute its systems in mid-Texas and western Lousiana, which serve 150,000 customers, and about $250 million in debt.
TCA Cable said it will contribute its adjoining and complementary systems, in areas serving 155,000 customers, and about $45 million in debt.
TCI said the proposed deal would help it make advances in its debt management plan while creating opportunities for better packaging, customer service and other operational efficiencies.
